option_relations.rationale: Poorly Differentiated Sigmoid Colon Adenocarcinoma is a specific type of Colorectal cancer.
Sarcomatoid Carcinoma of the sigmoid colon is a rare variant of colorectal carcinoma, which falls under the broader category of Colorectal cancer.
Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma is a type of soft tissue sarcoma, not specifically a colorectal cancer, although it can occur in the abdomen.
Leiomyosarcoma of the Colon is a type of soft tissue sarcoma originating from smooth muscle cells, not a colorectal cancer (which typically refers to adenocarcinoma).
